LESSON: NUMBER PUZZLE

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.6: Number puzzle

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Number puzzle
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. solve questions on Number puzzle
2. show clear working for Number puzzle

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Number puzzle

• Read the meaning of Number puzzle.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Number puzzle

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Number puzzle.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Number puzzle: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Number puzzle questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Number puzzle question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Number puzzle.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a revision sheet for Number puzzle with 5 worked examples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Show working.
• Check every answer.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
